Ipswich Town and Leicester City faced off on August 25, 2026, in a high-stakes Carabao Cup encounter that promised intense drama. Both sides looked to assert their dominance early on in a match where every tactical detail mattered for their progression in the tournament. A Deadlocked Opening Half The match ignited instantly, with Chuba Akpom nearly giving Ipswich Town the lead in the first minute, only to see his effort drift wide. Leicester City responded with persistent pressure, as Tom Watson and Louis Page tested Christian Walton ’s reflexes. Throughout the first period, the game was a tactical chess match; Ipswich looked dangerous through Kasey McAteer , while Leicester threatened via Conor Chaplin . Despite several corners and blocked shots, neither side could find the breakthrough before the referee blew for half-time. Second Half Surge The game transformed after the interval as the attacking intent from both managers intensified. In the 62nd minute, Sindre Egeli broke the deadlock for the hosts, slotting a left-footed strike into the bottom right corner following a clever setup by Jack Clarke . However, the lead was short-lived. Five minutes later, Leicester City found an equalizer when Olabade Aluko rose highest to head home a Bobby De Cordova-Reid cross following a corner, momentarily silencing the home crowd. The Marcelino Núñez Masterclass The final twenty minutes belonged to Marcelino Núñez . In the 71st minute, the midfielder restored Ipswich 's lead with a composed finish from outside the box, assisted by Chuba Akpom . As Leicester pushed forward in search of another leveler, the game became increasingly physical, resulting in yellow cards for Cédric Kipré and Louis Page . In the dying moments of stoppage time, Núñez produced a moment of pure magic. From over 35 yards out, he unleashed a thunderous strike that flew into the bottom left corner, leaving Jakub Stolarczyk helpless. The 3-1 victory was confirmed shortly after, sending Ipswich Town through to the next round following a dominant closing performance.
